items.period: Shang dynasty script style (modern redraw of an oracle-script form)
items.caption: A modern redraw of an oracle-script form interpreted as a face outline surrounding an eye.
items.alt: A compact, enclosed oracle-style character form, presented as a modern vector drawing.
items.selection_reason: Shows the face-outline and central-eye analysis associated with the earliest cited form tradition. The description page establishes the character and style; the pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage.
items.rights: Public domain release for the SVG representation; attribution appreciated but not required according to the Commons description page.

items.period: Shuowen small-seal script tradition; modern vector redraw
items.tradition: Small seal script, as attributed to Shuowen; modern redraw
items.caption: A modern redraw of the seal-script form recorded in the Shuowen tradition for 面.
items.alt: A seal-style outline character with enclosed inner strokes, drawn as a modern vector.
items.selection_reason: Pairs an early oracle-style image with the dictionary’s later seal-script tradition to illustrate graphic continuity without presenting either file as an artifact photograph. Pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage.
items.rights: Public domain release for the SVG representation; attribution appreciated but not required according to the Commons description page.

limitations.text: The oracle image direct fetch returned a cache-miss failure; the image URL is the exact original link listed on its inspected Commons file page. The image may need an alternate retrieval path.
Both proposed assets are modern vector redrawings. Neither is an artifact photograph, and image pixels were not inspected in this research stage.
